brief.objective: Animate an existing campaign key visual without redesigning its core composition.
brief.subject: The campaign key visual from @Image1
brief.action: Only the atmospheric particles, fabric accents and foreground light move while the central object remains structurally locked
brief.environment: Use the exact environment and palette of the key visual
brief.camera: Very slow 5 percent push-in, otherwise locked composition
brief.lighting: Preserve the original light direction; add only a subtle moving highlight
brief.endpoint: Composition finishes almost identical to the source image but feels alive
constraints: frame stays text-free for later compositing
